workflow:
version: 1
id: python-cleanup-serial
data: data.json
parallelism: 3
resources:
  disk_mb: 512
  max_heads: 3
steps:
  - id: spawn-compose
    kind: spawn
    needs: []
    retry: 0
    idempotent: false
    args:
      branch: python-cleanup-compose
      terminal_mode: headless
  - id: spawn-functional
    kind: spawn
    needs: []
    retry: 0
    idempotent: false
    args:
      branch: python-cleanup-functional
      terminal_mode: headless
  - id: spawn-sanitize
    kind: spawn
    needs: []
    retry: 0
    idempotent: false
    args:
      branch: python-cleanup-sanitize
      terminal_mode: headless
  - id: compose
    kind: exec
    needs: [spawn-compose]
    retry: 0
    idempotent: false
    args:
      argv: [sh,compose.sh]
      head: python-cleanup-compose
      timeout: 120
  - id: functional
    kind: exec
    needs: [spawn-functional,compose]
    retry: 0
    idempotent: false
    args:
      argv: [sh,verify.sh,functional]
      head: python-cleanup-functional
      timeout: 1500
  - id: sanitize
    kind: exec
    needs: [spawn-sanitize,compose,functional]
    retry: 0
    idempotent: false
    args:
      argv: [sh,verify.sh,sanitize]
      head: python-cleanup-sanitize
      timeout: 1500
